description: Schema for updating an existing inactive VEN cleanup schedule. Modify the configuration of a schedule that automatically removes VEN workloads that have been inactive for a specified duration. Update the name, target labels, inactivity threshold, or enable/disable status.

name.description: Name of the inactive VEN cleanup schedule

inactivity_threshold_in_hours.description: Number of hours of inactivity before VEN is considered for cleanup

enabled.description: Whether this cleanup schedule is enabled
